exam: 108年特種考試地方政府公務人員考試
subject: 程式語言

essays.text: 有一函式如下，試問其平均時間複雜度為何？（25 分）Function A(n) {int a = 0;int b = 0;for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {a++;}printf("Hello");for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {b++;}}printf("World");}

請指出下列程式碼不合理之處。（25 分）#include<stdio.h>#include<stdlib.h>int main(){int s ,t;scanf("%d%d", &s,&t);while (s < 30) {if (s < 100 || s >50) {t++;}else if (s > 60 && s<-1) {t++;}else if (s > 10 && s < 100) {t--;}elset++;}system("pause");return 0;}

試問下列程式碼的輸出為何？（25 分）#include <iostream>using namespace std;class A {public:int testa;A() :testa(100) {}virtual void f() {cout << "apple" << endl;}void g() {cout << "banana" << endl;}};class B : public A{public:B() :testb(300) {}void f() {cout << "cat" << endl;}void g() {cout << "dog" << endl;}int testb;};int main(){B b;A *a = &b;a->g();a->f();cout << a->testa << endl;cout << b.testb << endl;system("pause");return 0;}

試問下列程式碼的輸出為何？（25 分）#include<stdio.h>#include<stdlib.h>int main() {int i, k1 = 0, k2 = 0, k3 = 0;char a[] = "aA123bd45YH*#*";for (i = 0; a[i] != '\0'; i++)if ((a[i] >= 'a' && a[i] <= 'z') || (a[i] >= 'A' && a[i] <= 'Z'))k1++;else if ((a[i] >= '0') && (a[i] <= '9'))k2++;elsek3++;printf("%d,%d,%d\n", k1, k2, k3);system("pause");return 0;}
